title: HTTP

fields.name: host
fields.description: IP address or hostname of the target HTTP Server

fields.name: http_user
fields.description: Basic Auth Username

fields.name: http_passwd
fields.description: Basic Auth Password.

fields.name: aws_auth
fields.description: Enable AWS SigV4 authentication

fields.name: aws_service
fields.description: Specify the AWS service code, i.e.

fields.name: aws_region
fields.description: Specify the AWS region of your service, used by SigV4 authentication

fields.name: aws_sts_endpoint
fields.description: Specify the custom sts endpoint to be used with STS API, used with the AWS_Role_ARN option, used by SigV4 authentication

fields.name: aws_role_arn
fields.description: AWS IAM Role to assume, used by SigV4 authentication

fields.name: aws_external_id
fields.description: External ID for the AWS IAM Role specified with aws_role_arn, used by SigV4 authentication

fields.name: port
fields.description: TCP port of the target HTTP Server

fields.name: proxy
fields.description: Specify an HTTP Proxy.

fields.name: uri
fields.description: Specify an optional HTTP URI for the target web server, e.g: /something

fields.name: compress
fields.description: Set payload compression mechanism.

fields.name: format
fields.description: Specify the data format to be used in the HTTP request body, by default it uses msgpack.

fields.name: allow_duplicated_headers
fields.description: Specify if duplicated headers are allowed.

fields.name: log_response_payload
fields.description: Specify if the response paylod should be logged or not.

fields.name: header_tag
fields.description: Specify an optional HTTP header field for the original message tag.

fields.name: header
fields.description: Add a HTTP header key/value pair.

fields.name: json_date_key
fields.description: Specify the name of the time key in the output record.

fields.name: json_date_format
fields.description: Specify the format of the date.

fields.name: gelf_timestamp_key
fields.description: Specify the key to use for timestamp in gelf format

fields.name: gelf_host_key
fields.description: Specify the key to use for the host in gelf format

fields.name: gelf_short_message_key
fields.description: Specify the key to use as the short message in gelf format

fields.name: gelf_full_message_key
fields.description: Specify the key to use for the full message in gelf format

fields.name: gelf_level_key
fields.description: Specify the key to use for the level in gelf format

fields.name: body_key
fields.description: Specify the key to use as the body of the request (must prefix with "$").

fields.name: headers_key
fields.description: Specify the key to use as the headers of the request (must prefix with "$").

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of [workers](/manual/3.2/administration/multithreading.md#outputs) to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: The http output plugin allows to flush your records into a HTTP endpoint.
